scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:netlify: tsc -b && vite build --outDir dist && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/netlify-redirects.mjs
